descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Prague puts you in the captain's seat over the real Prague - with English and Czech menus.

THE REAL PRAGUE
Real satellite, elevation and map data: Prague Castle and St Vitus, Charles Bridge, the Old Town Square and the Astronomical Clock, Wenceslas Square, the Zizkov TV Tower, Petrin, Vysehrad, the Nusle Bridge, the Dancing House, Karlstejn and the Vltava bridges. Three airports: Vaclav Havel, Kbely and Vodochody.

A LIVING CITY
The red trams of lines 22 and 17, the Pendolino and the double-deck trains on their real tracks, Skodas and the red DPP buses on the roads, cruise boats and paddle steamers on the Vltava, airliners in the holding stacks. At night the Castle and the bridges are floodlit gold.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
Taxi and takeoff clearances, traffic calls and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar on the Vltava at Smichov, Vysehrad and the Castle out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the city approach to runway 24, Kbely, a Vltava run, UNDER the Nusle Bridge, Karlstejn, a fighter scramble, the Golden City after dark and a Prague tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
